title: Quantifying Threshold Manipulation in the Presence of Rounding: The Case of Lead Monitoring in U.S. Drinking Water
abstract: Many laws and economic actions depend on thresholds. As a consequence, threshold manipulation is a common concern in a variety of settings. Existing methods for detecting and quantifying threshold manipulation assume a continuous counterfactual distribution absent manipulation. This assumption is violated in the presence of rounding, which is prevalent in many applications and distinct from manipulation. This paper develops methods for testing and quantifying threshold manipulation when rounding is a prominent feature of the data. We demonstrate the usefulness of our approach in an empirical application examining threshold manipulation in lead monitoring under the US Safe Drinking Water Act. (JEL C24, I28, K32, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 许多法律和经济行为都依赖于阈值，因此，阈值操纵在各种情境中都是一个普遍关注的问题。现有的检测与量化阈值操纵的方法假定，在不存在操纵的情况下，反事实分布是连续的。当数据存在舍入（rounding）时，这一假定便不成立；而舍入在众多应用中普遍存在，且与操纵本身截然不同。本文提出了在舍入为数据显著特征时，检验和量化阈值操纵的方法。我们通过一项实证应用展示了该方法的实用性，该应用考察了《美国安全饮用水法》之下铅监测中的阈值操纵问题。（JEL C24, I28, K32, Q53, Q58）

title: Size-Based Regulations and Environmental Quality: Evidence from the U.S. Livestock Industry
Do Earmarks Target Low-Income and Minority Communities? Evidence from US Drinking Water
abstract: The quality and inequality of US drinking water investments have gained attention after recent environmental disasters in Flint, Michigan, and elsewhere. We compare the targeting of subsidized loans provided through the Safe Drinking Water Act with the targeting of congressional drinking water earmarks (“pork barrel” spending). Earmarks are critiqued for potentially privileging wealthier and politically connected communities. We find that earmarks target Black, Hispanic, and low-income communities, partly due to targeting water systems serving large populations. Earmark and loan targeting differ across all demographics we analyze. Compared to loans, earmarks disproportionately target Hispanic but not Black or low-income communities.
abstract_zh: 美国饮用水投资的质量与不平等问题，在密歇根州弗林特市及其他地方发生环境灾难后受到关注。我们比较了《安全饮用水法》提供的补贴贷款与国会饮用水专项拨款（“分肥式”支出）的分配对象。专项拨款因可能偏向较富裕且有政治关联的社区而受到批评。我们发现，专项拨款的对象包括黑人、西班牙裔和低收入社区，部分原因在于其瞄准了服务大量人口的供水系统。专项拨款与贷款在我们分析的所有人口特征上都存在差异。与贷款相比，专项拨款不成比例地瞄准西班牙裔社区，但并未如此瞄准黑人或低收入社区。

title: Environmental Justice and the Clean Water Act: Implications for Economic Analyses of Clean Water Regulations
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: Since President Clinton’s Executive Order 12898, federal agencies have been required to conduct environmental justice analyses of federal rules and regulations. More recently, the Biden administration instituted several efforts to reform regulatory review and promote a more equitable distribution of environmental benefits and burdens. This paper seeks to understand how prior guidelines have been implemented in federal regulatory reviews related to the Clean Water Act and provide a baseline for future studies of the distributional effects of clean water regulations. We reviewed 18 regulatory impact assessments relating to the Clean Water Act conducted since 1992. Only five of these studies conducted a quantitative analysis of distributional impacts, and none of the 18 assessments found disproportionately adverse effects on low-income or minority communities. Anticipating that future regulatory review will require more comprehensive distributional analyses, we combine national data on the location of regulated point sources with demographic characteristics to determine the baseline distribution of water pollution facilities. Overall, we find that discharge locations tend to be located in areas with higher poverty rates, higher White population shares, and less education. We find that rurality partly explains this pattern. We conclude with a discussion of the policy implications of these analyses.
abstract_zh: 自克林顿总统的第12898号行政令颁布以来，联邦机构被要求对联邦规章制度进行环境正义分析。近年来，拜登政府又实施了多项改革监管审查、促进环境收益和负担更公平分配的措施。本文旨在理解此前的指导方针如何在与《清洁水法》相关的联邦监管审查中得到实施，并为未来清洁水法规分配效应的研究提供基准。我们回顾了自1992年以来与《清洁水法》相关的18份监管影响评估。其中仅有5份开展了分配影响的定量分析，且这18份评估均未发现对低收入或少数族裔社区产生不成比例的不利影响。鉴于未来的监管审查将需要更全面的分配分析，我们将受监管点源的全国位置数据与人口特征相结合，以确定水污染设施的基准分布。总体而言，我们发现排污地点往往位于贫困率较高、白人人口比例较高、教育程度较低的地区。我们发现，农村属性部分解释了这一格局。最后，我们讨论了这些分析的政策含义。

title: Improving Private Well Testing Programs: Experimental Evidence from Iowa
Machine Learning Predicts Which Rivers, Streams, and Wetlands the Clean Water Act Regulates
abstract: We assess which waters the Clean Water Act protects and how Supreme Court and White House rules change this regulation. We train a deep learning model using aerial imagery and geophysical data to predict 150,000 jurisdictional determinations from the Army Corps of Engineers, each deciding regulation for one water resource. Under a 2006 Supreme Court ruling, the Clean Water Act protects two-thirds of US streams and more than half of wetlands; under a 2020 White House rule, it protects less than half of streams and a fourth of wetlands, implying deregulation of 690,000 stream miles, 35 million wetland acres, and 30% of waters around drinking-water sources. Our framework can support permitting, policy design, and use of machine learning in regulatory implementation problems.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了《清洁水法》保护哪些水体，以及最高法院裁决和白宫规则如何改变这一监管。我们利用航拍影像和地球物理数据训练了一个深度学习模型，以预测美国陆军工程兵团作出的15万份管辖权认定，每份认定都决定了对一处水资源的监管。根据2006年最高法院的裁决，《清洁水法》保护美国三分之二的溪流和一半以上的湿地；根据2020年白宫规则，它保护的溪流不足一半，湿地仅占四分之一，这意味着将放松管制69万英里溪流、3500万英亩湿地，以及饮用水源周边30%的水体。我们的框架可以支持许可审批、政策设计，以及机器学习在监管执行问题中的应用。

title: Economic Effects of Environmental Crises: Evidence from Flint, Michigan
abstract: In April 2014 Flint, Michigan switched its drinking water supply from the Detroit water system to the Flint River as a temporary means to save $5 million. Over 18 months it was revealed that the switch exposed residents to dangerous levels of lead, culminating in an emergency declaration in October 2015. This paper examines the impact of this crisis on the Flint housing market. The value of Flint’s housing stock has fallen by $520 million to $559 million despite over $400 million in remediation spending. Home prices remain depressed through August 2019, 16 months after the water was declared safe for consumption. (JEL H12, I12, Q25, Q51, Q53, R31)
abstract_zh: 2014年4月，密歇根州弗林特市为暂时节省500万美元，将饮用水供应从底特律供水系统切换为弗林特河。历时18个月，人们逐步发现此次切换使居民暴露于危险水平的铅中，并于2015年10月宣布进入紧急状态。本文考察了此次危机对弗林特住房市场的影响。尽管进行了超过4亿美元的修复支出，弗林特住房存量的价值仍下降了5.2亿至5.59亿美元。至2019年8月，房价仍然低迷，此时距宣布饮用水安全已过去16个月。（JEL H12, I12, Q25, Q51, Q53, R31）

title: Consequences of the Clean Water Act and the Demand for Water Quality
abstract: Since the 1972 U.S. Clean Water Act, government and industry have invested over |${\$}$|1 trillion to abate water pollution, or |${\$}$|100 per person-year. Over half of U.S. stream and river miles, however, still violate pollution standards. We use the most comprehensive set of files ever compiled on water pollution and its determinants, including 50 million pollution readings from 240,000 monitoring sites and a network model of all U.S. rivers, to study water pollution’s trends, causes, and welfare consequences. We have three main findings. First, water pollution concentrations have fallen substantially. Between 1972 and 2001, for example, the share of waters safe for fishing grew by 12 percentage points. Second, the Clean Water Act’s grants to municipal wastewater treatment plants, which account for |${\$}$|650 billion in expenditure, caused some of these declines. Through these grants, it cost around |${\$}$|1.5 million (2014 dollars) to make one river-mile fishable for a year. We find little displacement of municipal expenditure due to a federal grant. Third, the grants’ estimated effects on housing values are smaller than the grants’ costs; we carefully discuss welfare implications.
abstract_zh: 自1972年美国《清洁水法》颁布以来，政府和工业界已投入超过1万亿美元用于治理水污染，即每人每年约100美元。然而，美国仍有一半以上的溪流和河流里程违反污染标准。我们利用有史以来为水污染及其决定因素汇编的最全面文件（包括来自24万个监测点的5000万条污染读数，以及全美所有河流的网络模型），研究水污染的趋势、成因和福利后果。我们有三项主要发现。第一，水体污染浓度大幅下降。例如，1972年至2001年间，适合捕鱼的水体比例提高了12个百分点。第二，《清洁水法》对市政污水处理厂的拨款（其支出总额达6500亿美元）促成了部分降幅。通过这些拨款，使一英里河流在一年内达到可捕鱼标准的成本约为150万美元（2014年美元）。我们发现，联邦拨款导致的市政支出挤出效应很小。第三，拨款对住房价值的估计效应小于拨款成本；我们对福利含义进行了细致讨论。

title: The Low but Uncertain Measured Benefits of U.S. Water Quality Policy
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: US investment to decrease pollution in rivers, lakes, and other surface waters has exceeded $1.9 trillion since 1960, and has also exceeded the cost of most other US environmental initiatives. These investments come both from the 1972 Clean Water Act and the largely voluntary efforts to control pollution from agriculture and urban runoff. This paper reviews the methods and conclusions of about 20 recent evaluations of these policies. Surprisingly, most analyses estimate that these policies’ benefits are much smaller than their costs; the benefit–cost ratio from the median study is 0.37. However, existing evidence is limited and undercounts many types of benefits. We conclude that it is unclear whether many of these regulations truly fail a benefit–cost test or whether existing evidence understates their net benefits; we also describe specific questions that when answered would help eliminate this uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 自1960年以来，美国用于减少河流、湖泊及其他地表水污染的投资已超过1.9万亿美元，也超过了美国大多数其他环境举措的成本。这些投资既来自1972年《清洁水法》，也来自主要为自愿性质的农业及城市径流污染控制努力。本文回顾了约20项近期针对这些政策所作评估的方法与结论。令人意外的是，大多数分析估计，这些政策的收益远小于其成本；中位数研究的收益—成本比仅为0.37。然而，现有证据十分有限，且低估了许多类型的收益。我们的结论是：目前尚不清楚这些法规中的许多是否真的未能通过收益—成本检验，抑或现有证据低估了其净收益；我们也描述了若能回答便有助于消除这一不确定性的具体问题。

title: The Missing Benefits of Clean Water and the Role of Mismeasured Pollution
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Although the United States spends billions of dollars a year controlling water pollution, there is little empirical evidence of comparable benefits. This study argues that measurement error in pollution data causes benefits to be underestimated. Using upstream concentrations as instrumental variables for local concentrations, the study finds substantial benefits from reducing nutrient pollution. Instrumental variable estimates of the effects of phosphorus on recreational use are an order of magnitude larger than conventional estimates. The study uses a long-term pollution data set from Iowa to show that this difference is consistent with estimates of measurement error in several US water pollution data sets.
abstract_zh: 尽管美国每年花费数十亿美元控制水污染，但几乎没有可比的收益的实证证据。本研究认为，污染数据中的测量误差导致收益被低估。以上游浓度作为本地浓度的工具变量，本研究发现减少营养物污染带来了可观的收益。磷对娱乐性使用影响的工具变量估计值，比传统估计值大一个数量级。本研究利用爱荷华州的一个长期污染数据集表明，这一差异与美国多个水污染数据集中测量误差的估计结果相一致。

title: U.S. Water Pollution Regulation Over the Last Half Century: Burning Waters to Crystal Springs?
abstract: In the half century since the founding of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the U.S. has spent nearly $5 trillion ($2017) to provide cleaner rivers, lakes, and drinking water, or annual spending of 0.8 percent of U.S. GDP in most years. Yet over half of rivers and substantial shares of drinking water systems violate standards, and polls for decades have listed water pollution as Americans’ number one environmental concern. We assess the history, effectiveness, and efficiency of the Clean Water Act and Safe Drinking Water Act, and obtain four main conclusions. First, water pollution has fallen since these laws, in part due to their interventions. Second, investments made under these laws could be more costeffective. Third, most recent studies estimate benefits of cleaning up pollution in rivers and lakes which are much less than their costs. Either these analyses systematically understate the value of these investments or these investments are inefficient. Analysis finds more positive net benefits of drinking water quality investments. Fourth, economic research and teaching on water pollution is surprisingly uncommon, as measured by samples of publications, conference presentations, or textbooks.
abstract_zh: 自美国环境保护署成立以来的半个世纪里，美国已花费近5万亿美元（2017年美元）以提供更清洁的河流、湖泊和饮用水，即多数年份年均支出占美国GDP的0.8%。然而，超过一半的河流以及相当比例的饮用水系统仍不达标，且数十年来的民意调查均将水污染列为美国人最关心的环境问题之首。我们评估了《清洁水法》和《安全饮用水法》的历史、有效性和效率，得出四点主要结论。第一，自这些法律实施以来，水污染有所下降，部分原因在于这些法律的干预。第二，根据这些法律所作的投资本可更具成本效益。第三，近期大多数研究估计，清理河流和湖泊污染的收益远小于其成本。要么这些分析系统性地低估了这些投资的价值，要么这些投资本身是低效的。分析发现，饮用水质量投资的净收益则更为正面。第四，根据出版物样本、学术会议报告或教科书统计，水污染的经济学研究与教学出人意料地少见。

title: Air Pollution and Visitation at U.S. National Parks
abstract: Hundreds of millions of visitors travel to U.S. national parks every year to visit America's iconic landscapes. Concerns about air quality in these areas have led to strict, yet controversial pollution control policies. We document pollution trends in U.S. national parks and estimate the relationship between pollution and park visitation. From 1990 to 2014, average ozone concentrations in national parks were statistically indistinguishable from the 20 largest U.S. metropolitan areas. Further, relative to U.S. cities, national parks have seen only modest reductions in days with ozone concentrations exceeding levels deemed unhealthy by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. We find a robust, negative relationship between in-park ozone concentrations and park visitation. Still, 35% of all national park visits occur when ozone levels are elevated.
abstract_zh: 每年有数亿游客前往美国国家公园，欣赏美国标志性的自然景观。这些地区的空气质量问题引发了严格但存在争议的污染控制政策。我们记录了美国国家公园的污染趋势，并估计了污染与公园游客量之间的关系。1990年至2014年间，国家公园的平均臭氧浓度与美国20个最大都市区在统计上无显著差异。此外，相较于美国城市，国家公园中臭氧浓度超过美国环境保护署认定的不健康水平的天数仅有适度减少。我们发现公园内臭氧浓度与游客量之间存在稳健的负相关关系。尽管如此，仍有35%的国家公园游览发生在臭氧水平升高的时候。

title: Adapting to Climate Change Through Tile Drainage: Evidence from Micro Level Data
Air and Water: Integrated Assessment Models for Multiple Media
abstract: Economics has long provided the theoretical framework for efficient pollution management. Efficiency requires equating marginal damages of pollution emissions to their marginal control costs. Recent advances in integrated assessment models (IAMs) highlight the importance of estimating and incorporating marginal damages into pollution policy design. Concurrently, this work has also advanced pollution management at the macroeconomic level. Marginal damages play a critical role in tracking total damages of pollution through national accounts. This article reviews these recent advances and discusses the status of IAMs for air and water pollution. Several exciting research challenges for future IAMs are discussed.
abstract_zh: 经济学长期以来为高效的污染管理提供了理论框架。效率要求污染排放的边际损害与其边际控制成本相等。综合评估模型（IAM）的最新进展凸显了估计并将边际损害纳入污染政策设计的重要性。与此同时，这项工作也推动了宏观经济层面的污染管理。边际损害在通过国民账户追踪污染总损害方面发挥着关键作用。本文回顾了这些最新进展，并讨论了空气与水污染综合评估模型的现状。文中还讨论了未来综合评估模型面临的若干令人振奋的研究挑战。

title: Integrated Assessment Models of the Food, Energy, and Water (FEW) Nexus: A Review and Research Needs
The Effectiveness of Incomplete and Overlapping Pollution Regulation: Evidence from Bans on Phosphate in Automatic Dishwasher Detergent
Water-based Recreation and Water Quality Indices: A Revealed Preference Approach
abstract: Benefit estimates of water pollution control policies rely heavily on water quality indices. Since the 1970s, these measures of water quality have been used extensively in stated preference surveys to estimate willingness to pay for water quality that is suitable for recreational use. However, there is little empirical evidence of how well these indices correspond to observed recreational behavior. This paper utilizes a unique micro-dataset of individual household recreational use and water quality in a revealed preference framework to explore how well several major water quality indices explain water-based recreational use.
abstract_zh: 水污染控制政策的效益估计严重依赖水质指数。自20世纪70年代以来，这些水质衡量指标已被广泛用于陈述偏好调查中，以估计人们为获得适合娱乐用途的水质而愿意支付的金额。然而，关于这些指数与观察到的娱乐行为吻合程度的实证证据很少。本文利用一个独特的家庭微观数据集，即个体家庭娱乐使用情况与水质数据，在显示偏好框架下，探讨几种主要水质指数对水上娱乐活动的解释力。

title: Disentangling the Mechanisms Underlying Functional Differences among Microbial Communities
